actions.action: Check for roots circling or growing out of drainage holes and fast-drying soil
Repot into a pot 1-2 inches wider with drainage holes and chunky well-draining mix
Move plant to bright indirect light near a window
Rotate the plant every week or two
Fertilize with balanced houseplant fertilizer at half strength every 2-4 weeks in spring and summer
Prune lower side branches for height or tips for fullness, cutting above a node
Inspect white residue at trunk base for mold or mealybugs
Press trunks to check they are firm, not mushy
Check leaf undersides for spider mites or scale
Check top 2 inches of soil and water thoroughly only when dry

reason: The answer blames slow growth, light and nutrients and never notices the multiple tangled money trees, so its advice would not have led to untangling them. Its generic care tips are not harmful.
